name: @lilitoweiwei/dsh-web-pwa
description: Install metadata for an installed DSH Web app: serves a Web App Manifest with raster icons and taps index.html so the browser fetches that manifest with credentials. Exists because Chrome parses an SVG-only manifest icon as 0x0 (not installable) and fetches manifests with credentials omitted (a reverse proxy in front of DSH answers the login page instead).
